svg.title: Phase 02: Scoring moves into the agent. 14–16 Jul 2026 · fixes 7–12. A scheduled task, a CV snapshot gated by a sha256 hash, and a reliability layer of checksummed writes and a self-checking build. Why: “Two failures on one day, a stale journal and a truncated template, taught that a write is not done until it is read back.”
svg.text: A scheduled task, a CV snapshot gated by a sha256 hash, and a
